A slower kind of escape

Room to breathe.
Space to belong.

Set in the hills of Gangtok, The Himalayan House is imagined as a quiet base for discovering Sikkim. Mornings begin with changing mountain light; afternoons are for wandering; evenings invite you to settle in.

Simple comforts, considered details and a sense of place make the stay feel less like a stopover, and more like your own corner of the mountains.
